title: Chiral-Angle-Controlled Altermagnetic Spin Splitting in Nanotubes
verdict_detail: Bulk d-wave altermagnet spin splitting reproduced (net M=0, diagonal nodes exact, analytic-vs-Bloch diff=0). Zone-folded nanotube axial spin splitting follows cos(2theta) with R^2=1.000, node at 45 deg, antinodes at 0/90 deg, robust across tube indices N=8,12,16. DFT first-principles confirmation not attempted (cluster-only) and noted as out of scope, not a failure.
